competency_alignment.rationale: Every sample directly assesses the competency of measuring mass using scales. The tasks consistently ask students to read a measuring instrument and report mass in specified units, which is the core skill targeted by the MATATAG Grade 3 Quarter 2 competency for mass measurement.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: All three requirements are demonstrably addressed: measuring mass is shown through scale-reading tasks in all 19 samples; grams, kilograms, and milligrams all appear across the sample set with multiple examples of each unit; and measuring tools are represented consistently through the ScaleRead visual component.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: All three units required by the competency are well-represented.
